$comment: THE Foundation capability register. This document — not any module — is the population the Universal Foundation Constitution (UCOS-UFC-001) governs. Registering a Foundation capability is an entry here and requires NO change to constitution.py, conformance.py, convergence.py or freeze.py; UFC-09 is measured by proving those governing modules contain none of the identities below. Every field is a declaration a probe resolves live: an entry that names something absent produces a FAULT, never a silent pass.
$nucleus_comment: UFC-17 Ω Nucleus completeness. Every entry below carries a 'nucleus' profile: the facets of its constitutional universe that no gate already proves. Each leaf states 'present' with the evidence that realises it, or 'not-applicable' with the reason it does not apply. There is deliberately no third value and no default — a facet nobody wrote down is MISSING, and MISSING blocks freeze, because 'it does not apply here' is a determination somebody has to make and sign.
$locator_note: A string literal matching this shape is a repository locator and therefore a project fact that UFC-13 requires to live in a declared document rather than in code. Declared catalogue documents are data and are never scanned.
$replay_comment: UFC-11 register currency. Every capability SHALL state whether its outputs become Repository Truth. The claim is NOT trusted: probe_certifiable walks the capability's own source for the calls in conformance.ARTIFACT_WRITE_CALLS and fails the article when the declaration and the measurement disagree in either direction. A capability that begins emitting artifacts therefore fails FG-11 until it declares a replay target, which is the executable form of 'a measurer that adds files must re-measure after its own commit'. A declared target is a module:attribute callable that re-renders the committed output so the render can be proven a fixed point at the commit that carries it.

capabilities.name: Universal Repository Truth Framework
capabilities.description: What counts as Truth, determined by declared zone policy rather than by any hardcoded path. The one Repository Truth model.

ownership.evidence: Sole canonical owner of MODEL-TRUTH in the convergence register; every other surface that answers 'what counts as Truth' is recorded there as delegating to it.

truth_binding.evidence: Classifies but never emits. Its determinations are DERIVED and never become canonical Truth, which is why it declares no replay target and why FG-11 finds no artifact write in its source.

context.evidence: Holds for any repository that declares zones. Assumes no path, no zone name, no population size and no filesystem layout: the zone vocabulary is constitutional, the population is a project declaration.

composition.evidence: Root of the Foundation dependency order. Every other Foundation nucleus classifies through it and it imports none of them, which is what keeps the composition graph acyclic at its root.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: This register entry is the documentation of record: identity, contracts, service, extension points, registries, catalogues and dependencies are read from the declaration rather than restated beside it.

tests.evidence: Its conformance suite is derived rather than authored: the shipped probes execute every article against this declaration, so a newly legislated obligation reaches it without a test being written for it.

monitoring.evidence: Watched by the constitutional conformance gate, which executes every article against it on the repository's canonical verification entry point.

signals.evidence: Emits a content-addressed TruthPartition carrying per-zone counts and an explicit unclassified population — an absence it reports rather than absorbs.

measurement.evidence: Measured by UCOS-UMPF-001 through the declared truth-classification coverage policy. It computes no headline number of its own, so no second measurement of its population can exist.

traceability.evidence: Traceable through this register entry to UCOS-UFC-001, and through the convergence register to MODEL-TRUTH and to every subordinate surface that once answered for it.

evidence.evidence: Produces the content-addressed TruthPartition, whose identity derives from its inputs alone and holds no wall-clock, so what was classified is recoverable from the classification.

evolution.evidence: Evolves by registering a zone declaration or an eligibility rule in its declared catalogue. A new zone requires no change to this framework and no amendment to the law.

security.evidence: Read-only classification over declared locators. Holds no credential, opens no socket, performs no filesystem read at import, and admits no input it was not handed.

compliance.evidence: Held to UCOS-UFC-001 and to nothing else. Its obligations are the articles of that law, each bound to one executable gate, so compliance is measured rather than attested.

commercialization.rationale: Foundation infrastructure consumed only by other Foundation nuclei. It is not offered as a product in its own right and has no standalone value proposition.

billing.rationale: Not metered. No classification it performs is priced and no consumer of it is charged, so there is no meter to declare.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. This nucleus publishes no separate terms and grants none.

marketplace.rationale: Not independently listable: outside a Foundation composition that specialises it with a declared zone policy it classifies nothing.

capabilities.name: Universal Ownership Framework
capabilities.description: Who owns a subject, determined from constitutional evidence only and never inferred. The one ownership model.

ownership.evidence: Sole canonical owner of MODEL-OWNERSHIP; the engine-side resolver that once answered the same question is recorded superseded and must be absent for the model to converge.

truth_binding.evidence: Determines who owns a subject and emits nothing. Its determination is DERIVED; the declarations it reads are Truth, the conclusion it reaches is not.

context.evidence: Holds wherever ownership can be evidenced by declaration. Assumes no owner vocabulary, no organisational shape and no realisation rule: an owner is whoever the declared evidence names.

composition.evidence: Composes Repository Truth by reference to decide which zones may hold ownership at all, and is composed in turn by the Foundation platform. It owns no peer.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: This register entry is the documentation of record, including both extension points and both provider registries, so the pluggable surface cannot be documented differently from how it is measured.

tests.evidence: Its conformance suite is derived rather than authored: the shipped probes execute every article against this declaration, and the retired resolver's measurement is reproduced against the live repository.

monitoring.evidence: Watched by the constitutional conformance gate and by the convergence gate, which additionally proves the retired second determination is still absent.

signals.evidence: Emits an OwnershipDetermination carrying per-reason counts, coverage and an explicit unresolved population, so what it could not determine is visible rather than defaulted.

measurement.evidence: Measured by UCOS-UMPF-001 through the declared ownership coverage policy. Governance reduction proposes only for subjects this one determination left open.

traceability.evidence: Traceable through this register entry to UCOS-UFC-001, and through the convergence register to MODEL-OWNERSHIP and to the superseded surface it replaced.

evidence.evidence: Every determination names the evidence provider and the reason that produced it, so an ownership answer can always be traced to the declaration that justified it.

evolution.evidence: A new source of ownership evidence is a registered provider. Admitting one requires no change to this framework and no change to any consumer of it.

security.evidence: Reads declarations, writes nothing, and refuses to infer. Absence of evidence yields an unresolved subject rather than an assigned owner, which is the failure mode that matters here.

compliance.evidence: Held to UCOS-UFC-001 and to nothing else. Its obligations are the articles of that law, each bound to one executable gate.

commercialization.rationale: Foundation infrastructure consumed only by other Foundation nuclei. It is not offered as a product in its own right.

billing.rationale: Not metered. No determination it makes is priced and no consumer of it is charged.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. This nucleus publishes no separate terms and grants none.

marketplace.rationale: Not independently listable: without a declared ownership ledger and a Truth policy to bound it, it determines nothing.

capabilities.name: Universal Source Assimilation Framework
capabilities.description: How anything — document, export, record set, API response — becomes admitted content with a declared destination. The one assimilation model.

ownership.evidence: Sole canonical owner of MODEL-ASSIMILATION; every adapter implements its one declared contract and is resolved through its one registry rather than answering for itself.

truth_binding.evidence: Decides whether a declared destination is a legitimate home by asking Repository Truth, and admits content there. What it admits may become Truth; the admission report itself is DERIVED.

context.evidence: Holds for any source of any shape — document, export, record set, API response — because the source-kind vocabulary is open and the adapter set is registered rather than enumerated.

composition.evidence: Composes Repository Truth by reference to bound its destinations, and is composed by the Foundation platform. It is never the thing that decides where content may live.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: This register entry is the documentation of record, including the declared policy-free posture, so its specialisation story cannot be documented differently from how it is measured.

tests.evidence: Its conformance suite is derived rather than authored: the shipped probes execute every article against this declaration.

monitoring.evidence: Watched by the constitutional conformance gate, which executes every article against it on the repository's canonical verification entry point.

signals.evidence: Emits an AssimilationReport carrying per-state counts, per-reason breakdown, unit totals and coverage, so a refused source is visible as a refusal rather than as a smaller number.

measurement.evidence: Measured by UCOS-UMPF-001 through the declared assimilation coverage policy; it publishes counts and computes no verdict about them.

traceability.evidence: Traceable through this register entry to UCOS-UFC-001, and through the convergence register to MODEL-ASSIMILATION and its declared adapter surface.

evidence.evidence: Every admitted unit carries its source, its adapter and its declared destination, so admitted content can always be traced back to what admitted it.

evolution.evidence: A new source format is a registered adapter and a declared source kind. Neither requires a change to the pipeline, which is the whole reason the vocabulary is open.

security.evidence: Admits only sources it is handed and only to destinations Truth policy permits. It opens no network connection and performs no filesystem read at import.

compliance.evidence: Held to UCOS-UFC-001 and to nothing else. Its obligations are the articles of that law, each bound to one executable gate.

commercialization.rationale: Foundation infrastructure consumed only by other Foundation nuclei. It is not offered as a product in its own right.

billing.rationale: Not metered. Assimilation volume is reported but never priced, and no consumer of it is charged.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. This nucleus publishes no separate terms and grants none.

marketplace.rationale: Not independently listable: without a declared source manifest and destination map it has nothing to assimilate.

capabilities.$policy_note: The declared source-kind vocabulary and adapter set are the framework's own reusable content, not a project policy: a project specialises assimilation through the Foundation specialisation's source manifest and destination map, never through a document owned here.

capabilities.name: Universal Measurement Policy Framework
capabilities.description: How any determination is measured, by registered policy rather than by a branch inside an engine. The one measurement model.

ownership.evidence: Sole canonical owner of MODEL-MEASUREMENT; the measurements that were once branches inside a closure engine are registered policies here, and the composed Foundation reports its suite rather than a number beside it.

truth_binding.evidence: Measures what other nuclei determined and emits nothing. Its PolicySuite is DERIVED: recomputable from the same inputs, and therefore never canonical.

context.evidence: Holds for any determination expressible as a MeasurementContext. Assumes no metric, no threshold and no notion of what 'closed' means: which policies bind, and which of them block, are declarations.

composition.evidence: Composes Truth, ownership and assimilation by reference so that one population yields one measurement — the structural reason two Foundation surfaces cannot report different numbers for the same subjects.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: This register entry is the documentation of record, and the policy catalogue is the documentation of which measurements bind — neither is restated in prose that could drift from it.

tests.evidence: Its conformance suite is derived rather than authored: the shipped probes execute every article against this declaration.

monitoring.evidence: Watched by the constitutional conformance gate, and by the platform-scoped one-measurement gate that proves no second surface reports on its population.

signals.evidence: Emits a PolicySuite carrying every policy outcome, its value, whether it blocks, and the identities of the policies withholding closure — so a blocked determination always names its blockers.

measurement.evidence: Measures itself through the same registered policies it applies to everything else; there is no privileged path by which its own numbers are produced differently.

traceability.evidence: Traceable through this register entry to UCOS-UFC-001, and through the convergence register to MODEL-MEASUREMENT and its declared policy catalogue.

evidence.evidence: Each policy outcome carries the policy identity, the measured value and the declared threshold that judged it, so a verdict can always be re-derived from what produced it.

evolution.evidence: A new measurement is a registered policy with declared blocking and precedence. Changing what 'closed' means is a declaration, never an edit to an engine.

security.evidence: Pure computation over supplied context. Holds no credential, reads no file at import and reaches no ambient state.

compliance.evidence: Held to UCOS-UFC-001 and to nothing else. Its obligations are the articles of that law, each bound to one executable gate.

commercialization.rationale: Foundation infrastructure consumed only by other Foundation nuclei. It is not offered as a product in its own right.

billing.rationale: Not metered. It produces the numbers a meter would read but is not itself charged for.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. This nucleus publishes no separate terms and grants none.

marketplace.rationale: Not independently listable: without a declared policy catalogue and a determination to measure it produces an empty suite.

capabilities.name: Universal Foundation Constitution
capabilities.description: The one law every Foundation capability obeys, with one executable probe per article and a measured convergence and freeze determination.

ownership.evidence: Sole canonical owner of MODEL-IMPLEMENTATION: one article set, one probe per article, one capability register. The Provider Constitution is a narrower authority governed under it, not a second copy of it.

truth_binding.evidence: The law is CANONICAL and the register that carries its population is a DECLARATION; every determination it produces is DERIVED. It writes nothing, which is why it declares no replay target.

context.evidence: Holds for any Foundation capability in any repository. The domain set is closed so the law is bounded; the population inside each domain is data so the content is unbounded — bounded law, unbounded content, deliberately.

composition.evidence: Composes nothing and is composed by everything: it declares no dependency so that no capability can be required to exist before the law that governs it.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: The articles are the documentation: each carries its own mandate text and the gate that proves it, so the law and the description of the law are the same object and cannot diverge.

tests.evidence: Every article ships with exactly one executable probe. A gate with no bound probe is reported UNBOUND and a probe that cannot execute FAULTs, so an untested article is visible rather than assumed satisfied.

monitoring.evidence: Bound into the repository's canonical verification entry point, so conformance is continuously enforced rather than measurable on demand.

signals.evidence: Emits a ConformanceDetermination carrying every gate result with its findings, the maturity axes reached, and the blockers withholding conformance.

measurement.evidence: Measures maturity from executed probes rather than from declared status: an axis is reached only when every gate proving it passed, and an unmeasured axis is an absence rather than a pass.

traceability.evidence: Every gate result carries the article it proves and the capability it was measured against, and the determination pins the content hash of the law it was measured under — so a certification remains recoverable after the law is amended.

evidence.evidence: Every gate result is content-addressed over its verdict and its findings, so the evidence for a verdict is carried with the verdict and a re-measurement that reached the same conclusion produces the same identity.

evolution.evidence: A capability is added by an entry in the register; a stricter probe is added by registration; a new obligation is an amendment with an executable gate. UFC-09 is measured by proving no governing module names any registered identity.

security.evidence: Read-only and fail-closed. It writes nothing, starts no server, opens no socket, and reports a fault rather than a pass on any input it cannot measure.

compliance.evidence: Holds itself to its own articles: it is a registered capability in the register it governs, and is measured by the same probes as every other nucleus. No self-exemption exists.

commercialization.rationale: A constitution is not a product. It is the law under which products are admitted, and it is consumed only by the Foundation it governs.

billing.rationale: Not metered. Governance is not a metered service, and pricing conformance would create an incentive to measure less of it.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. This nucleus publishes no separate terms and grants none.

marketplace.rationale: Not independently listable: the law has no meaning apart from the population it governs.

capabilities.name: Universal Foundation Platform
capabilities.description: The composition in which Truth, ownership, assimilation and measurement become one determination, specialised by one declared document per project.

ownership.evidence: Owns the composition, not the models: it holds no Truth, ownership, assimilation or measurement implementation of its own, and the convergence register records its bootstrap as delegating to the one ownership framework.

truth_binding.evidence: The project specialisation it reads is a DECLARATION; the FoundationDetermination it produces is DERIVED and content-addressed. It writes nothing, which is why it declares no replay target.

context.evidence: Holds for any project that can supply one specialisation document. Every project-specific fact — zone, path, population, assignment, grain — lives in that document, which is the mechanical reason a repository-specific fix has nowhere to be written.

composition.evidence: The terminal composition of the Foundation: it depends on all five other nuclei and nothing depends on it, so it is the one place the whole determination becomes a single answer.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: This register entry plus the project specialisation are the documentation of record: what the platform composes and how a project specialises it are both read from declarations.

tests.evidence: Its conformance suite is derived rather than authored: the shipped probes execute every article against this declaration, including the composition article that proves each declared dependency is really imported.

monitoring.evidence: Watched by the constitutional conformance gate and by the freeze readiness determination, which withholds readiness for an unmeasured criterion exactly as firmly as for a failed one.

signals.evidence: Emits a FoundationDetermination carrying the headline verdict, the blockers withholding closure, and the per-capability projections beneath it — and reports an input it was not given as not measured rather than as empty.

measurement.evidence: Measured by UCOS-UMPF-001: the composed determination is the policy suite the one measurement engine produced, and the platform computes no headline number beside it.

traceability.evidence: The determination identity is content-addressed over the identities of the partition, ownership, assimilation and measurement it composed, so every headline number traces to the four determinations that produced it.

evidence.evidence: Produces a content-addressed, wall-clock-free determination fit for certification; its fingerprint pins exactly what was determined.

evolution.evidence: A project joins by declaring a specialisation; a capability joins by an entry in the register. Neither is a change to this composition, which is why the platform grows without the composer being edited.

security.evidence: Composes only what it is handed and refuses a malformed specialisation with a typed error. It writes nothing, starts no server and opens no socket.

compliance.evidence: Held to UCOS-UFC-001 and to nothing else. It is a registered capability in the register that law governs, and is measured by the same probes as every other nucleus.

commercialization.evidence: The one Foundation surface with standalone value: a project obtains a complete constitutional determination by supplying one specialisation document and composing nothing itself.

billing.rationale: Not metered in this repository. It is composed in-process by the repository that carries it; no determination it produces is priced and no consumer is charged.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. This nucleus publishes no separate terms and grants none.

marketplace.evidence: Independently listable as the composed Foundation: it is the unit a consuming project would adopt, and its declared specialisation surface is the whole of what such a consumer must supply.

capabilities.name: Universal Ω Nucleus Generator
capabilities.description: The first production generator: one Ω Nucleus declaration in, the complete constitutional artifact set out. It renders from the declaration alone and writes nothing, because a plan is a determination and materialising it is a constituent act.
capabilities.$replay_rationale: A generator that wrote would be the single most dangerous writer in the repository: its output carries the authority of the declaration it derives from. It therefore renders into a content-addressed plan and stops. FG-11 measures this against its own source rather than believing the declaration.

ownership.evidence: Sole owner of the question 'what artifacts does one Ω Nucleus declaration require'. It answers no other question: request governance, blueprint compilation and execution dispatch are separate models with separate owners, and this nucleus imports none of them.

truth_binding.evidence: Reads DECLARATIONS and produces a DERIVED plan. The artifacts it determines would become Truth only when a separate constituent act materialises them under the authority that governs their destination.

context.evidence: Holds for any nucleus in any repository and any language. Assumes no directory layout — destinations resolve from tokens the declaration itself answers — and no artifact set, because the target register is data.

composition.evidence: Composes UCOS-UFC-001 by reference to read declarations, and is composed by no one: generation is a terminal act over the register rather than a stage inside it.

api.evidence: The published surface is a ContractRef tuple derived from one declared name list at one declared version, so the API cannot carry a ref the declaration does not name.

documentation.evidence: This register entry and the declared target document are the documentation of record: what a generation produces is read from the targets, never restated in prose beside them.

tests.evidence: Its conformance suite is derived rather than authored, and its own rendered output is held to the same standard: every generated Python artifact is parsed as a test, so a template that emits invalid source fails rather than ships.

monitoring.evidence: Watched by the constitutional conformance gate, and by its own readiness command, which resolves every declared destination for every registered nucleus and reports the ones no declaration can answer.

signals.evidence: Emits a content-addressed GenerationPlan carrying every artifact's destination, digest and line count, so what would be written is inspectable before anything is.

measurement.evidence: Measured by UCOS-UMPF-001 like every other nucleus, and by the readiness determination, which counts how many registered nuclei the Foundation can generate in full.

traceability.evidence: Every artifact identity covers its target, its kind, its destination and its content, so a generated file traces to the obligation that required it and the declaration that shaped it.

evidence.evidence: The plan fingerprint pins the whole artifact set. Two runs over one declaration produce the same fingerprint, which is what makes a generated artifact re-derivable rather than merely reproducible in principle.

evolution.evidence: A new obligation for every future nucleus is an entry in the target register; a new way to render an existing obligation is a template registration. Neither is an edit to the generator.

security.evidence: Writes nothing, reads no filesystem during rendering, imports no nucleus it generates for, and executes no rendered content. The blast radius of a malicious declaration is a string nobody has yet acted on.

compliance.evidence: Held to UCOS-UFC-001 and to nothing else. It is a registered nucleus in the register it generates for, and is measured by the same probes and the same facet contract as every other.

commercialization.evidence: The Foundation's product surface: a consumer supplies one declaration and receives a complete, conformant nucleus. This is the capability that makes the Foundation something one adopts rather than something one reads.

billing.rationale: Not metered in this repository. Generation is composed in-process by the repository that carries it; no plan is priced and no consumer is charged per artifact.

licensing.evidence: Carried under the project licence declared in the build manifest. Generated artifacts inherit the licence of the repository that materialises them; this nucleus grants no separate terms.

marketplace.evidence: Independently listable: it requires only a declaration conforming to the register's shape, and its declared target document is the whole of what a consumer would specialise.
